findings.summary: Source job idempotency lookup is global across tenants and units.
findings.details: enqueueSourceJob queries sourceProcessingJobs by idempotencyKey alone and immediately returns an existing workId when present. Because idempotencyKey is caller-supplied source job input and the row also carries organizationKey/unitKey, a colliding idempotency key from another organization or unit can reuse the wrong workId and skip creating the tenant's own source job. This violates tenant isolation and replay/idempotency safety for the new fenced workpool boundary.
